note: Banque Misr's card fees and rates (dated 1 September 2026): its Classic credit card costs 250 pounds to issue for the first year and 250 to renew, written as a yearly fee, and bears 4% a month on a decreasing balance, calculated on the monthly statement. CIB's fee schedule answered with a bot check and wasn't read.
